facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports Cameroon currently operates about 12,000 km of terrestrial fibre-optic network plus about 812 km of overhead fibre on electricity poles, all managed by state operator Camtel; it does not list regions served. As of date is the article's published date.
facts.system: Camtel national fibre optic transmission backbone

systems.system: National fibre optic transmission backbone, Phase IV extension
systems.country_label: Phase IV of the national fibre optic transmission backbone expansion project
systems.owner: Camtel (state); financed by China Eximbank, Huawei-backed

note: Phase IV: decree of 6 March 2026 authorises signing a 1.35bn yuan loan; up to 4,000 km more is only possible, so no contract and no building fact.
